source_block.text: 2.1 Installation and Authorization

scope: Actual source heading/route
assessment: Numbered heading only, no behavior inferred.

source_block.text: Before getting started with Live, make sure you have the latest version of the software installed and authorized. You can download the Live installer from your ableton.com User Account and then launch it to install the software. Once installed, you can authorize Live. Note that each Live license comes with two authorizations, so you can use the software on up to two computers, providing that you only use one computer at a time.

scope: Installer from user account; launch then authorize; two authorizations / two computers / one at a time.
explicit_facets: two authorizations / two computers / one at a time.
assessment: The existing U-DELIVERY group names installation/authorization but does not resolve this publisher entitlement prose. Preserve as source context, not legal interpretation, target entitlement or installer protocol.

scope: Actual source heading/route
assessment: Numbered heading only, no behavior inferred.

source_block.text: There are different options available within Live and externally to help you get familiar with the application and music making in general.

scope: Orientation to internal and external learning resources.
explicit_facets: Orientation to internal and external learning resources.
assessment: No distinct input/output law.

source_block.text: Live includes two built-in learning tools: the Learn View for guided lessons, and the Info View for context-sensitive help. For further exploration, there are resources available outside of the application. These include this manual, videos, and interactive web apps.

scope: Learn guided lessons; Info contextual help; external manual/videos/interactive web apps.
assessment: Learn and Info owners below provide partial roles. External destination behavior is not specified or visited.

source_block.text: Live’s Learn View includes structured learning modules that combine video content with written explanations and guide you through Live’s interface and key features step by step. New modules will continue to be released over time and can be added to the Learn View at any point, so you don’t have to wait for a Live update to access new content. At the bottom of Learn View’s home page, you can find links to this manual and the Knowledge Base.

Unless you close Live in the meantime, the Learn View will return to the last visited page next time you open the view, so you can jump back into a lesson at any time.

source_block.text: While we encourage you to familiarize yourself with all of the content in the manual, we especially recommend reading the Live Concepts chapter, which encapsulates everything that Live is and can do. source_block.text: Ableton also offers two websites, Learning Music and Learning Synths, which cover the basics of music making and using synthesizers respectively. No prior experience or equipment is needed; you can interact with the content directly in your browser.

source_block.text: Audio setup varies between macOS and Windows. On macOS, Live’s input and output can be connected to any CoreAudio device.
